$pareto_set: list of integer indices into sweep_table identifying the non-dominated configurations (maximise throughput, minimise tx_power_mw)
$notes: P2 pareto: per-config RT path-solve + PHY LDPC QPSK 1/2 BLER -> throughput. sweep_table has 15 rows (5 az x 3 power). pareto_set is the list of indices (into sweep_table) of non-dominated configs in (throughput-max, tx_power_mw-min) space. tx_power_mw = 10^(tx_power_dbm/10). Output files: simulation.py, simulation_result.json. MUST call sionna.rt.PathSolver and sionna.phy.* in the simulation script.
